title: lathyrus maritimus f. albescens
intro: Lathyrus maritimus f. albescens, commonly known as Beach Lathyrus, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the pea family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its use in reducing inflammation and promoting cardiovascular health due to its high levels of antioxidants and other nutrients. The therapeutic actions of Beach Lathyrus include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which can be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Beach Lathyrus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
